source.title: DNT
source.description:
Behind me you'll find a rather large portal leading into the Emerald Dream. Unfortunately, it's more of a "nightmare" on the other side right now, and that's off limits for me at the moment. As if the nightmare manifesting wasn't enough, there's something in there, a nightmare amalgamation made of horrific dreams and prophetic visions of doom.

So of course I need you to go in and find it's lair for me. Take the measure of this creature so that we can decide what to do next.
